reviews.rationale: Accept provisional NO at the 2026-10-14 cutoff only. I independently rendered the held original and acting PDFs after checking their raw hashes and read the complete EO10030 at 14 FR377, EO11485 at 34 FR15411 and its printing correction at 34 FR15443. EO10030 contains exactly two recurring norms: paragraph 1 delegates and directs administration with an express federal-service/emergency-duty exclusion; paragraph 2 requires recommendations at appropriate times. Neither is a one-off appointment or a deadline. EO11485 section 5 expressly supersedes the entire named EO10030 with present-tense hereby wording and no deferred or partial qualifier. The actor's complete sections 1-4 establish successor arrangements, including Attorney General consultation for appointments, and preserve no operative old-order command. The correction replaces only the last sentence of actor section 1; section 5 and the October 1, 1969 date remain untouched. Historical acts, appointments and liabilities are not adjudicated extinguished. I read the two frozen target observations and supporting actor note as dependent editorial leads, not independent legal proof; 1989 is only a snapshot and 2026 retrieval dates are not legal events. Bounded catalogue/local results and fresh NARA tables support the named supersession and disclose no revival. I read the complete held EO14339 text; its new 2025 directions do not revive EO10030. This is not an exhaustive absence finding. EO11403 section 3 authorizes callups and emergency action but proves no actual callup or release; PL85-270 changes rank/terminology without ending paragraph 2. The unresolved 1949/1956 continuity and actual paragraph 1 suspension episodes remain material lifecycle questions, not evidence of present survival. No unseen lifecycle claim, exact first cessation for every operative episode, canonical status or owner adoption is approved.
